descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Your Opportunity: As a Junior Graphic Designer you will collaborate with senior designers, clients, and team members to understand design requirements and objectives. They'll assist in developing design solutions that effectively communicate messages and align with project goals. By leveraging their creative skills and design software knowledge, they contribute to the production of various design assets across different mediums, including print, digital, and social media. Junior Graphic Designers work under the guidance of senior designers to ensure consistency and adherence to brand guidelines in their design deliverables. They assist in the creation of layouts, selecting appropriate typography, and incorporating visual elements to enhance the overall visual appeal. Support the design team in creating visually compelling designs, gaining hands-on experience, and developing their skills in various design aspects. Junior Graphic Designers play a crucial role in assisting the team to deliver high-quality designs that effectively communicate messages and contribute to the overall success of design projects. Responsibilities
• ● Assist in the creation and production of various marketing collateral outputs through AI tools, delivering high-quality and visually appealing designs.
• ● Support the development of visually appealing and on-brand designs that effectively communicate the organization's message and objectives.
• ● Collaborate with senior designers and cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver design solutions that meet stakeholder expectations.
• ● Execute design tasks with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and adherence to brand guidelines.
• ● Perform administrative tasks using Google Sheets, Google Drive and other tools, ensuring accurate documentation and project alignment for design requests.
• ● Contribute to brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to generate new ideas and concepts.
• ● Stay updated on design trends, techniques, and software tools to enhance design capabilities and suggest innovative ideas.
• ● Take ownership of assigned design projects, managing time and resources effectively to meet deadlines.
• ● Seek feedback from senior designers and incorporate revisions to rene design concepts and deliver high-quality work.
• ● Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.
• ● Utilize design software and tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite (Adobe Express, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), to help create and renew designs.
• ● Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
• ● Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Who you are You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends. Further requirements
• ● 1-2 years of professional experience in graphic design, either through internships, freelance work, or entry-level positions.
• ● Prof
